---
title: "EDA Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    css: styles.css
params: 
  result_list: "[result_list]"
  output_dir: "[output_dir]"
---

```{r, echo = FALSE}

# Define a list of paths to .Rmd files for each location
rmd_paths <- list(
	"1" = "pettitt/pettitt-report.Rmd",
	"2" = "mks/mks-report.Rmd",
	"4" = "pettitt/pettitt-report.Rmd",
	"6" = "mks/mks-report.Rmd",
	"8" = "mk/mk-report.Rmd",
	"10" = "spearman/spearman-report.Rmd",
	"12" = "bbmk/bbmk-report.Rmd",
	"14" = "pp/pp-report.Rmd",
	"15" = "kpss/kpss-report.Rmd",
	"17" = "sens/sens-report.Rmd",
	"18" = "white/white-report.Rmd",
	"19" = "mwmk/mwmk-report.Rmd",
	"21" = "sens/sens-report.Rmd"
)

# Due to the strange behaviour of knitr, I cannot use asis_output in the for loop
outputs <- character()

# Iterate through the list of locations and generate a report for each one
for (result in params$result_list) {

# Get a bunch of variables from result for convenience
start <- result$start	
end <- result$end
location <- result$location
index <- toString(result$location)

# If the location is a decision/branching point, add the message
if (location %in% c(3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 16, 20)) {

	# Determine whether the point is a decision point or branching point
	point <- ifelse(location %in% c(3, 5, 7), "Decision", "Branching")

	# Add the decision/branching point message to the report	
	msg <- glue("*{point} Point*: {result$msg}")
	outputs <- c(outputs, glue("---\n\n{msg}\n\n---"))
	next	
}

# Generate a subheader if this location is the beginning of a section
if (location %in% c(1, 4, 6)) { 
	header <- glue("## Change Point Analysis ({start}-{end})")
	outputs <- c(outputs, header)
} else if (location == 8) {
	header <- glue("## Trend Identification in AMS Means ({start}-{end})")
	outputs <- c(outputs, header)
} else if (location == 18) {
	header <- glue("## Trend Identification in AMS Variance ({start}-{end})")
	outputs <- c(outputs, header)
}

# Define a list containing the other arguments
args <- list(
	output_dir = params$output_dir,
	show_years = FALSE,
	start = start,
	end = end
)

# Handle special case for  Sen's trend estimator
if (location == 17) args$data_type <- "mean"
if (location == 21) args$data_type <- "variance"

# Then generate a report for this test
env <- new.env()
env$params <- c(result$results, args)
outputs <- c(outputs, knit_child(rmd_paths[[index]], envir = env))

}

# Annoying hack (see above)
asis_output(paste(outputs, collapse = "\n\n"))
```
